text:
Someday from one side of the moon

you will see fall the kisses that shine in me

the shadows will smile haughtily

displaying the secret that moans wandering

the impassive leaves will come

that one day were

what my eyes were

the withered fragrances will come

that innate descended from the winged sound

the red joys will come

that bubble intensely

in the sun that rounds the equidistant harmonies

in the dancing smoke

of the pipe of my love.

translation.title: Someday from One Side of the Moon...
translation.editorial_note: The translation leaves the early surreal syntax strange rather than smoothing its leaps.
